description:
Create a precision template for a 22-fret electric guitar fretboard in LibreCAD. 

Starting from a blank drawing (Millimeters), create the following:

1. Layers: 'OUTLINE' (White), 'FRETS' (Red), 'INLAYS' (Cyan), 'CENTERLINE' (Yellow).

2. Fret Slots (Layer 'FRETS'): Draw 22 vertical lines at these X-coordinates (distance from nut at X=0): 36.37, 70.70, 103.10, 133.68, 162.55, 189.79, 215.51, 239.79, 262.70, 284.32, 304.73, 324.00, 342.18, 359.35, 375.55, 390.84, 405.27, 418.90, 431.76, 443.89, 455.35, 466.16.

3. Outline (Layer 'OUTLINE'): Draw a tapered fretboard shape. Nut width is 43mm (centered at X=0, so Y from -21.5 to +21.5). Heel width is 56mm (centered at X=466.16, so Y from -28 to +28). Connect these points and close the shape.

4. Inlays (Layer 'INLAYS'): Draw 6mm diameter circles centered horizontally between frets at: Fret 3, 5, 7, 9, 15, 17, 19, 21 (on Y=0 centerline). For Fret 12, place two dots centered horizontally, spaced vertically at Y=12 and Y=-12.

Save the result to '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/fretboard_template.dxf'.
